'''Gulvitch''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Gulvitch system/Legends|Gulvitch system]]. It was situated in the [[Loop Worlds]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] connected it to the [[Arkuda system/Legends|Arkuda]] and [[Bronsoon system/Legends|Bronsoon systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to<ref name="TEA" /> [[43 ABY]],<ref name="43 ABY">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which describes Gulvitch, ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Gulvitch was [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by members of the [[Bagmim]] and [[Povanarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which [[Homeworld/Legends|originated]] on the nearby worlds of [[Xochtl]] and [[Povanaria]], respectively. By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Gulvitch was a struggling colony that was only visited by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who had been experiencing misfortunes and were looking for inexpensive cargoes to pick up.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gulvitch was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
